text: Algorithm 1 Decoupled relation Subspace Alignment (DRSA) 0: Features { X τ } \{X_{\tau}\} , Relations { R r } \{R_{r}\} , Hyperparams { k , γ , β } \{k,\gamma,\beta\} , Iterations { T } \{T\} 0: Aligned representations { H τ } \{H_{\tau}\} 1: Initialize H τ , P τ , E τ H_{\tau},P_{\tau},E_{\tau} 2: Initialize projections A τ , B τ A_{\tau},B_{\tau} 3: for i ​ t ​ e ​ r = 1 iter=1 to T T do 4: // Stage 1: Structure-driven update 5: for each node type τ \tau do 6: Compute Σ τ ′ = H τ ′ ⊤ ​ H τ ′ \Sigma_{\tau^{\prime}}=H_{\tau^{\prime}}^{\top}H_{\tau^{\prime}} 7: C τ ← β ​ I C_{\tau}\leftarrow\beta I , B τ ← 0 B_{\tau}\leftarrow 0 8: for each relation r : τ → τ ′ r:\tau\rightarrow\tau^{\prime} do 9: M r ← A τ ​ B τ ′ ⊤ M_{r}\leftarrow A_{\tau}B_{\tau^{\prime}}^{\top} 10: C τ ← C τ + M r ​ Σ τ ′ ​ M r ⊤ C_{\tau}\leftarrow C_{\tau}+M_{r}\Sigma_{\tau^{\prime}}M_{r}^{\top} 11: B τ ← B τ + ( R r ​ H τ ′ ​ M r ⊤ ) ⊤ B_{\tau}\leftarrow B_{\tau}+(R_{r}H_{\tau^{\prime}}M_{r}^{\top})^{\top} 12: end for 13: for each relation r : τ ′ → τ r:\tau^{\prime}\rightarrow\tau do 14: M r ← A τ ′ ​ B τ ⊤ M_{r}\leftarrow A_{\tau^{\prime}}B_{\tau}^{\top} 15: C τ ← C τ + M r ⊤ ​ Σ τ ′ ​ M r C_{\tau}\leftarrow C_{\tau}+M_{r}^{\top}\Sigma_{\tau^{\prime}}M_{r} 16: B τ ← B τ + ( R r ⊤ ​ H τ ′ ​ M r ) ⊤ B_{\tau}\leftarrow B_{\tau}+(R_{r}^{\top}H_{\tau^{\prime}}M_{r})^{\top} 17: end for 18: H τ ← ( C τ − 1 ​ B τ ) ⊤ H_{\tau}\leftarrow(C_{\tau}^{-1}B_{\tau})^{\top} 19: end for 20: // Stage 2: Feature decomposition 21: for each node type τ \tau do 22: P τ ← ( X τ ⊤ ​ X τ + γ ​ I ) − 1 ​ X τ ⊤ ​ ( H τ − E τ ) P_{\tau}\leftarrow(X_{\tau}^{\top}X_{\tau}+\gamma I)^{-1}X_{\tau}^{\top}(H_{\tau}-E_{\tau}) 23: E τ ← 1 1 + β ​ ( H τ − X τ ​ P τ ) E_{\tau}\leftarrow\frac{1}{1+\beta}(H_{\tau}-X_{\tau}P_{\tau}) 24: H τ ← X τ ​ P τ + E τ H_{\tau}\leftarrow X_{\tau}P_{\tau}+E_{\tau} 25: end for 26: end for 27: return { H τ } \{H_{\tau}\}
